user_decisions.plan: Full study, same protocol, cap $30 (user chose this option in answer to the plan-change question)
user_decisions.pc_stays_on: Yes: a local watchdog (Windows scheduled task) supervises, downloads and closes
user_decisions.agent_budget: The user has no agent limit for roughly the next 20 hours and asked for an unattended run with a status command and a way to download results afterwards
user_decisions.rental_approval: The user approved the rental and asked for Sonnet reviews of the code before it

deviation_from_frozen_layout.what: Each endpoint runs as contiguous --start/--stop pieces, each in a fresh process (84 pieces: HellaSwag 15x600, GSM8K 2x644, others whole). The protocol shards field is not read by any admission or pairing code; protocol hash and scoring are unchanged.
deviation_from_frozen_layout.why: The earlier HellaSwag scoring refused on three adapters after about 3510 per-forward torch.profiler sessions in one process. The cause is consistent with a per-process session limit but not proven.
guards: driver probe reproduces the empty-kernel-name condition before any weights are downloaded and refuses if it does not appear before 2800 cycles
exact CPU forward count per piece must be at most 1400 (plan step)
a refused piece is never retried; the run stops and packages its evidence

reuse_and_fallback.fallback: After the first new piece (oracle L1024 BoolQ) a CPU check pairs it with the old BoolQ piece. If it cannot pair, the two old pieces are moved aside and scored again on this host.

identity_restoration: The 27 shard mtime_ns values are restored from the frozen protocol between download and convert; a dry admission with the resident evaluator and all four adapters must pass before any scoring.
workstation_deviation: Runbook line 38 forbids a watchdog/automatic deleter; the user explicitly asked for an unattended run and approved it. The watchdog only touches the recorded instance and volume.
private_backup: Kaggle credential refused; results are downloaded to the workstation instead
smoke_evidence: watchdog destroy() was run against a real 1 GB throwaway volume and verified absent; driver success/failure/STOP/crash/packaging-failure/lock paths and every watchdog tick branch were exercised with stubs; none of this ran on the host
first_launch_failure: setup.sh failed after 22 s because the venv python3 on PATH has no uv; fixed by calling /usr/bin/python3 explicitly; the watchdog task was disabled during the repair, setup was relaunched, no scientific command had run

probe_result.limits_of_the_probe: No model, one attention call per cycle, about 2 ms per profiler session, so it did not run the evaluator conditions (resident NF4 model, 27 attention calls per forward, LoRA, 3270 s wall time). It does not show that the real evaluator would not refuse.
probe_result.driver_stopped_as_designed: The driver refused with PROBE_NOT_REPRODUCED at 08:21:39 UTC, before any weights were downloaded.

user_waiver_probe_gate.question: Continue after a negative probe, stricter probe, or stop and delete
user_waiver_probe_gate.user_choice: Continue anyway, stop at the first refusal
user_waiver_probe_gate.effect: The probe is informational. HellaSwag now runs first in every adapter cell so a refusal appears early; any refused piece still stops the run, packages the evidence and lets the watchdog delete the host.

known_limits_of_the_running_code: The probe marker is overwritten by a bare timestamp; the probe result is in evidence/h2-profiler-probe.json and the driver log. Cosmetic; not changed on the live host.
A short HellaSwag piece (about 1000 forwards) does not test the long-process hypothesis: no piece gets near 3510 forwards. A pass avoids the observed failure without explaining it.
The initial-adapter hash check confirms the seed/PEFT/torch environment, not NF4 payload equality; payload equality remains unproven.
The Windows task runs only while the user is logged in; sleep on AC is disabled, a reboot or logoff stops supervision.
